def transform(ctx):
    sheet = "VIEW"
    hdr_row = 1
    last = ctx.used_last_row(sheet)
    if last <= hdr_row:
        raise ValueError("데이터가 없습니다.")
        
    ho_col = ctx.find_header(sheet, "호유형", header_row=hdr_row)
    com_col = ctx.find_header(sheet, "상품명", header_row=hdr_row)
    
    def col_letter_of(n):
        s = ""
        while n:
            n, r = divmod(n - 1, 26)
            s = chr(65 + r) + s
        return s

    com_col_str = col_letter_of(com_col)
    
    ho_range = f"{ho_col_str}2:{ho_col_str}{last}"
    com_range = f"{com_col_str}2:{com_col_str}{last}"

    com_data = ctx.read(sheet, com_range)
    
    out = []

        c = str(com_data[i][0] or "")

    ctx.write(sheet, ho_range, out)

Sub B2BSkill()
    On Error GoTo Cleanup
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook
    
    Dim wsSrc As Worksheet, wsDst As Worksheet
    Set wsSrc = wb.Worksheets("발신번호별_호유형_통화요금_합계")
    Set wsDst = wb.Worksheets("할인후합계")
    
    ' 1. 원본 시트에서 "국제호" 열 찾기 (2행 헤더 기준)
    Dim intCol As Long, c As Long, lastC As Long
    intCol = 0
    lastC = wsSrc.Cells(2, wsSrc.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    For c = 1 To lastC
        If Trim(CStr(wsSrc.Cells(2, c).Value)) = "국제호" Then
            intCol = c
            Exit For
        End If
    Next c
    If intCol = 0 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "'국제호' 열을 찾지 못했습니다."
    
    ' 2. 원본 데이터 읽기 (A열: 발신번호, 국제호 열)
    Dim lastRowSrc As Long
    lastRowSrc = wsSrc.Cells(wsSrc.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRowSrc < 3 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "원본 데이터가 부족합니다."
    
    Dim keyArr As Variant, valArr As Variant
    keyArr = wsSrc.Range(wsSrc.Cells(3, 1), wsSrc.Cells(lastRowSrc, 1)).Value
    valArr = wsSrc.Range(wsSrc.Cells(3, intCol), wsSrc.Cells(lastRowSrc, intCol)).Value
    
    ' 3. Dictionary 생성 (키=발신번호, 값=국제호)
    Dim dict As Object
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To UBound(keyArr, 1)
        Dim key As String
        key = Trim(CStr(keyArr(i, 1)))
        If Len(key) > 0 Then
            If Not dict.Exists(key) Then
                dict.Add key, valArr(i, 1)
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 4. 대상 시트 처리
    ' 발신번호 열(A열) 서식 설정 (식별자 보호)
    wsDst.Columns("A").NumberFormat = "@"
    
    ' 대상 범위 읽기/쓰기 (A9:A2000 -> B9:B2000)
    Dim dstArr As Variant
    dstArr = wsDst.Range("A9:A2000").Value
    Dim outArr() As Variant
    ReDim outArr(1 To UBound(dstArr, 1), 1 To 1)
    
    Dim r As Long
    For r = 1 To UBound(dstArr, 1)
        Dim dstKey As String
        dstKey = Trim(CStr(dstArr(r, 1)))
        If Len(dstKey) > 0 Then
            If dict.Exists(dstKey) Then
                outArr(r, 1) = dict(dstKey)
            Else
                outArr(r, 1) = ""
            End If
        Else
            outArr(r, 1) = ""
        End If
    Next r
    
    ' 결과 값으로 일괄 쓰기
    wsDst.Range("B9:B2000").Value = outArr
    
Cleanup:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Raise Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description
    End If
End Sub
